exceptionTypeQualificationCells.correction: Qualify only the captured ListException type as System.ListException; keep ExceptionMessage exact.

remainingUnpredictedFailures.nativePrimaryDiagnostic: Illegal assignment from String to Integer
remainingUnpredictedFailures.observedPrimaryDiagnostic: method "observe" initializes Integer local "incompatible" with String
remainingUnpredictedFailures.cause: Named semantic diagnostics lack native text for String-to-Integer initialization. The anonymous route has native text; the existing lifecycle projection also lacks this assignment pair, so applying that projection alone is insufficient.

anonymous-context.cause: Transient anonymous-local Apex contexts are accepted by the generic builder instead of rejected as unsupported standard-library types.
anonymous-context.proposal: Classify captured anonymous declaration contexts from runtime declaration provenance before formula parsing; return the captured unsupported-type diagnostic. Do not classify from the class name.

public-context.cause: The build-time global check is limited by a name-dependent type rule and runs after formula validation. Ordinary named public contexts must fail first with the captured context type must be global diagnostic.
public-context.proposal: Validate the captured named context access before expression validation, using class access metadata. Retain the captured global and SObject success twins and the separate anonymous-local rejection.

standard-context.cause: String.class gets an empty definition and a field-access diagnostic instead of the captured unsupported standard library type diagnostic.
standard-context.proposal: Reject the captured String context before field validation. Other standard types need separate native captures.

member-visibility.cause: Formula context definitions include public members of global classes; native exposes only the captured global member twins.
member-visibility.proposal: Build a formula-specific visible-member definition from access metadata; for the captured public record member, return Field record does not exist. Check spelling. Keep global fields and properties accepted.

getter-precedence.cause: Every declared instance field/property is initialized to a stored default. The formula walker reads that slot before checking the getter, so the computed inherited record property stays null even when currentValue holds an Account.
getter-precedence.proposal: Use declared property getter dispatch before its backing slot for the captured global computed property; preserve direct SObject reads, ordinary fields, automatic properties and null-cast twins. Getter exception propagation, counts and repetition on global contexts need native captures before behavior changes.

contains-null.cause: CONTAINS coerces a null source to empty text and returns false; these FormulaInstance rows return null natively.
contains-null.proposal: Preserve null for the captured CONTAINS(null field, A) FormulaInstance expressions. Restrict the change to the captured formula surface; do not extrapolate to DML formulas, other functions or argument shapes.
